meta.title: Remove 'submodules: recursive' from GitHub Actions workflows
meta.body_summary: Remove unnecessary `submodules: recursive` parameter from all GitHub Actions workflow checkout steps, claiming slight workflow efficiency improvement since submodules have been removed.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot removed submodules:recursive from workflows but accidentally removed unrelated fields; after review feedback, PR restored correctness and merged quickly with maintainer's LGTM.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 476 changed lines across 31 workflow files, this is a small-to-medium cleanup by absolute volume. As a CI-focused performance PR, it merged quickly after correcting an accidental removal of unrelated fields.

review_details.concern_detail: harupy noticed that the initial removal also deleted unrelated fields like 'repository', 'with:', and 'script:' sections in cross-version-tests.yml. After feedback, Copilot restored them, then harupy reverted and applied a clean fix.
review_details.performance_claim: Removing submodules: recursive slightly improves workflow efficiency by avoiding unnecessary submodule checkout.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Batch removal across many workflow files requires accurate diff to avoid collateral deletion; initial failure shows agent weakness in handling YAML structure context.

detection_detail.code_reading: harupy reviewed the diff and identified that unrelated fields were removed in cross-version-tests.yml, prompting a rollback and clean re-application.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No before/after CI timing or benchmark data; performance claim is narrative only.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: After initial mistaken removal, Copilot restored fields; harupy then reverted the initial commit and manually applied the correct fix removing only the submodules line.

core_change_summary.description: Removes the 'submodules: recursive' parameter from the checkout step in 29 GitHub Actions workflow YAML files under .github/workflows/. Additional cleanup included removing empty 'with:' sections and restoring accidentally deleted fields.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Merge from master brought changes to CONTRIBUTING.md and removed dev/Dockerfile.protos; unrelated to perf change.
change_trajectory: Copilot removed submodules: recursive from all workflow files, accidentally deleting unrelated YAML fields.
harupy noted accidental deletions; Copilot restored fields in cross-version-tests.yml.
harupy reverted the original removal commit.
harupy manually applied a clean fix removing only the submodules line.
